node.subject: english
node.title: 围绕主题表达观点
node.summary: 围绕主题表达自己的观点
node.content_req: 围绕主题表达自己的观点
node.academic_req: 能在日常话题讨论中，用 I think... because... 结构清晰阐述个人立场，并给出至少两个支撑理由。
key_points: 围绕主题表达自己的观点
能用英语说出「I think... because...」句式表明自己的观点
能为同一观点提供至少两条不同理由进行支撑
能在讨论中坚持自己的立场并回应不同意见
node.assessment_prompt: 给主题「Do you like {{name}}?」，能不能用英语说出至少 2 句理由表达喜欢或不喜欢？\n讨论「Should students wear school uniforms?」时，{{name}}会不会用「I think... because」结构发表自己立场？\n被问到「What is your favorite subject and why?」，{{name}}能不能用 3 句话以上说出自己最喜欢的科目及原因？
node.title_pinyin: wei rao zhu ti biao da guan dian
node.description: 围绕主题表达观点就是让孩子当「小小辩论家」——给定一个主题（比如「该不该养宠物」），能用英语说出「I think... because...」表明立场。
node.real_examples: 人教版 PEP 五年级下册 Unit 3 'My school calendar' Part B Read and write 中要求学生用「I like... because...」句型介绍自己喜欢某个月份的理由；外研版五年级上册 Mod
node.common_mistakes: 学生把「I think play football is fun」写成「I think play football is fun」（漏写动名词 playing）；学生把观点和原因混在一句话里写成「I like spring because
node.teaching_activity: 用 6 张主题卡（天气/食物/动物/季节/科目/运动）发给 6 个小组，让孩子每组抽 1 张卡，必须用「I like... because...」句型说出 2 条以上理由，计时 2 分钟看哪组说得又多又准；然后让小组互换卡片，再练 1 遍，
node.teaching_voice: 我们来看,围绕主题表达观点就是要说出你的立场和理由。比如看到同学在养仓鼠,你就说'I think we should keep pets, because they make us happy, because they teach us responsibility.'记住,至少给两个理由,别人反驳时,再用一个'I still think...'坚持你的观点。

exercises.question: Tom and Lily are discussing whether students should have homework every day. Lily says: 'I think we should have less homework, because it takes too much time, because we need more time to play and rest.' Which sentence best shows Lily expressing her opinion with reasons?
exercises.explanation: B正确,用'I think...because...'明确立场+两个理由。A只一个理由;C无立场;D是疑问句,没有表达观点。
options: A. I like homework because it is fun.
B. I think we should have less homework, because it takes too much time, because we need more time to play and rest.
C. Homework is so boring every day.
D. Do we really need homework every day?

exercises.question: Mike wants to express his opinion about keeping pets at school. He writes: 'I ____ we should keep pets, ____ they can make us happy.' Please fill in the two key words.
exercises.explanation: 本句考查'I think...because...'句式,think表明观点,because引出理由,缺一不可。

exercises.question: Your classmate says: 'I think we should not play computer games on school days.' How do you respond to keep your own opinion and give at least two reasons?
exercises.answer: I still think we can play computer games a little on school days, because it helps us relax after class, because it can also teach us some skills. (坚持立场用'I still think...',至少给出两个because理由。)
exercises.explanation: 评分要点:1. 用'I still think...'坚持自己立场 2. 至少给出两个不同理由(由because引出) 3. 理由合理、与主题相关。

exercises.question: Scenario: Your school is planning a 'No Plastic Bags Day' next Friday. Some classmates think it's a great idea, but others say it's too hard to remember to bring cloth bags every day. You need to share your opinion in the class meeting. Write at least 2 sentences using 'I think... because...' to state your view and give two reasons to support it.
exercises.answer: 审题: 围绕「是否支持无塑料袋日」这一主题, 用 'I think... because...' 句式表达立场, 并给出至少两条理由. 分析: 关键在于「明确观点」+「两条不同角度的理由」(如环保、习惯、便利性). 解答: I think we should have 'No Plastic Bags Day', because plastic bags are very bad for the environment and they pollute the ocean. Also, because using cloth bags can help us form a good habit of protecting the Earth from an early age. (观点清晰, 用 because 给出环保和习惯培养两个理由.)
exercises.explanation: 1. 明确使用 'I think...' 表明立场, 观点要清晰. 2. 使用 'because...' 给出至少两条不同维度的理由 (如环保、习惯养成). 3. 句式完整、逻辑连贯, 体现「小小辩论家」的表达要求.

exercises.question: Class Discussion: 'Should students be allowed to bring smartphones to school?' Your classmate Tom says: 'I think students should NOT bring smartphones to school, because they distract us in class.' But your classmate Lily disagrees and says: 'I think students SHOULD bring them, because parents need to contact us in emergencies.' Write your own opinion (2 reasons) AND respond to one classmate's argument using 'I still think...'. (3 sentences in total)
exercises.answer: 审题: 围绕「学生能否带手机上学」这一辩论主题, 需包含「自己观点+两条理由」+「用 I still think 回应他人」三部分. 分析: 这是压轴题型, 既考「围绕主题表达观点」(本概念), 又考「坚持立场并回应不同意见」(本概念进阶). 解答: I think students should NOT bring smartphones to school, because they can affect our study and sleep. Also, because we can use school phones to call parents when needed. I still think phones should not be allowed, Tom, because even one phone ring can break everyone's attention during an important lesson. (结合了禁止的两条理由, 并直接回应了 Tom 的干扰学习观点.)
exercises.explanation: 1. 第一句用 'I think... because...' 表明清晰立场, 并给出至少 2 条不同理由 (学习、替代方案). 2. 至少有一条理由与 Tom/Lily 的不同角度, 体现「两条不同理由支撑」. 3. 第二句用 'I still think... because...' 回应同学, 体现「坚持立场并回应不同意见」. 4. 句式准确, 表达连贯, 符合辩论语言规范.
